### Run the Race to Win - Leading The Way - Devotional for August 14
Author: Michael A. Youssef, Ph.D.
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/leading-the-way/leading-the-way-devotional-for-august-14-2026.html
Passage: 1 Corinthians 9:24
Points:
- Worldly runners chase fleeting career goals, but Christians run for God's eternal glory.
- Believers run not against one another, but against obstacles, temptation, and the enemy.
- Running to win demands spiritual discipline and self-control rather than following fickle feelings.
- Christians willingly make sacrifices because the prize is an imperishable crown.
- Those who feel disqualified can return to God's training program and regain spiritual momentum.

### The BCS Title Game, Perishable Wreaths and the Gospel of Jesus Christ
Author: Mike Pohlman
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-devo/crosswalk-the-devotional-jan-8-2009-11597872.html
Passage: 1 Corinthians 9:24-27
Points:
- Elite athletes endure rigorous preparation and bodily strain for trophies that perish.
- Worldly athletic devotion should inspire believers to invest greater effort into eternal pursuits.
- Christians are called to disciplined spiritual training because godliness holds eternal value.
- The gospel grounds believer hope in an unfading inheritance won through Christ.
- Runners in Christ must strain forward purposefully rather than living aimlessly.
